characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If an Army's Primary Detachment is from the Legio Custodes Army List, the Controlling Player gains one additional Reaction Point if the Army contains any Models with the Golden Exemplar Trait.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Reaction allows the Reacting Unit to split into two new Units when an enemy Unit ends its move within 12".

characteristics.name: Trigger
characteristics.$text: Once per Battle, the Reactive Player may declare a The Blade Splits Advanced Reaction in Step 2 of the Move Sub-Phase process, if an enemy Unit ends a move within 12" and Line of Sight of a Unit under the Reactive Player's Control.

characteristics.name: Cost
characteristics.$text: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a The Blade Splits Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Move triggered the Advanced Reaction. Once the cost has been paid, the Reactive Player must select one Unit under their control that is within 12" and has Line of Sight to the Target Unit, and which contains only Models with the Legio Custodes and The Sodality Traits, and which also contains at least six Models. That Unit is the Reacting Unit.

characteristics.name: Process
characteristics.$text:
1. Once the The Blade Spits Advanced Reaction has been declared, the Active Player must completely resolve the Target Unit's Movement.
2. Once the Target Unit has finished its move, the Reactive Player must move a number of Models from the Reacting Unit. When making this move, the Reactive Player must move at least three Models from the Reacting Unit a number of inches up to the Base Value of each Model's Initiative Characteristic so that they are no longer in Unit Coherency with the rest of the Reacting Unit, but are in Unit Coherency with each other. Once this movement is complete, there must still be at least three Models from the Reacting Unit which did not move and which are still in Unit Coherency with each other.
3. Once this movement has been resolved, the Models from the Reacting Unit which moved are considered to form a new Unit separate from the rest of the Reacting Unit for all purposes, including the scoring of Victory Points (excluding the Last Man Standing (X) Secondary Objective). All Models which were in the Reacting Unit when The Blade Splits Advanced Reaction was declared are considered to have made a Reaction in this Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Gambit grants a Model additional attacks based on the number of enemy Models in the Combat from which the Model was selected.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this Gambit is selected, then if the Opposing Player may claim a greater Outside Support Bonus in the Focus Step than the Controlling Player, the Model for which it was selected gains a bonus to its current Attacks Characteristic in the following Strike Step equal to the difference in the Outside Support Bonuses the Players could claim for the Challenge, to a maximum of +3.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Gambit halves a Model's Attacks Characteristic but replaces the Critical Hit (6+) Special Rule with Critical Hit (5+) on its Weapons.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this Gambit is selected, then as long as the Model for which it was selected is declared to be using a Weapon with the Critical Hit (6+) Special Rule at the beginning of the Focus Step, that Special Rule is replaced with the Critical Hit (5+) Special Rule and that Model's Base Attacks Characteristic is halved for the duration of the Strike Step.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Gambit modifies a Model's Toughness by +1 but causes Wound Tests made for it to fail on a 1 or 2.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This Gambit may only be selected for a Model with the 'Shield' Trait. If this Gambit is selected, then the Model for which it was selected gains a +1 modifier to its Toughness Characteristic for the duration of the Strike Step, but any Wound Tests made for that Model in the same Strike Step automatically fail on a natural result of 1 or 2.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Gambit limits a Model to one attack but sets that attack's Damage Characteristic to the Model's remaining wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this Gambit is selected, the Model for which is was selected may only make a single attack in the following Strike Step regardless of its Attacks Characteristic, but the Damage Characteristic of the Weapon used to make that attack is modified to be equal to the Model's current Wounds Characteristic while that attack is resolved.

sharedRules.name: Master of the Golden Legion
sharedRules.description: If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Fear (1) Special Rule is granted to all Models with the Legio Custodes Trait and the Infantry, Cavalry, Walker or Paragon Type in the same Army until the end of the first Battle Turn.

sharedRules.name: Only In Death
sharedRules.description: Whenever a Model with this Special Rule would gain the Routed Tactical Status in the Make Panic Checks Step of the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, that Model instead gains the Stunned Tactical Status, unless there are any Models without this Special Rule in the same Unit as that Model. Additionally, a Unit which only contains Models with this Special Rule may never have the Disengage or Fall Back aftermath options selected for it, unless it is entirely composed of Models which also have the Antigrav Sub-Type, in which case it may still have the Disengage aftermath option selected for it.

rules.name: Master of the Golden Legion
rules.description:
If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Fear (1) Special Rule is granted to all Models with the Legio Custodes Trait and the Infantry, Cavalry, Walker or Paragon Type in the same Army until the end of the first Battle Turn.


Furthermore, if a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then once per Turn, when the Controlling Player makes a Reserves Test for a Unit which only contains Models with the Legio Custodes Trait and the Deep Strike Special Rule, before the Reserves Test is made, that Player can select to modify that roll by +1. If this modifier is applied, that Unit must be deployed using the Deep Strike Special Rule.

rules.name: The Blade of Mercy
rules.description:
The Controlling Player selects a single Model in this Unit which has a Misericordia to resolve Steps 4-10 of the Resolving an Initiative Step sequence with, targeting one enemy Unit from the selected Combat which has had the Fall Back aftermath option selected for it. Attacks made as part of this aftermath option are resolved using the following profile:


*This Melee Weapon’s Damage Characteristic is equal to the number of Models with a Misericordia in the Unit for which this aftermath option has been selected

rules.name: Misericordia
rules.description:
A Unit containing any Models with a Misericordia may select a unique aftermath option in which it makes a special attack against an enemy Unit from the same Combat.


A Unit which contains any Models with a Misericordia may have the Blade of Mercy aftermath option selected for it in Step 4 of the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase for any Combat in which that Unit has won or drawn the Combat.

rules.name: Arae-shrike
rules.description:
A Model with an arae-shrike gains the Deep Strike Special Rule and confers it to any Unit it joins, and can apply a penalty to Enemy Reserve Tests.


A Model with an arae-shrike gains the Deep Strike Special Rule, and if it joins a Unit entirely composed of Models with the Legio Custodes Trait in Reserves, all Models in that Unit also gain the Deep Strike Special Rule.

In addition, in the Effects Sub-Phase of the End Phase of their Player Turn, the Controlling Player of a Model with an arae-shrike which is on the Battlefield can make an Intelligence Check for that Model. If that Check is successful, then the opposing Player must apply a -1 modifier to the result of the first Reserves Test they make in the Reserves Sub-Phase of the subsequent Player Turn. 
Any Reserves Test may only be modified by a single arae-shrike in this manner.

rules.name: Eclipse Shield
rules.description:
Eclipse shields grant a 5+ Shrouded Damage Mitigation Roll against Shooting Attacks once a Model suffers a Penetrating Hit.


The first time in a Battle Turn a Model with an eclipse shield suffers a Penetrating Hit, it gains a 5+ Shrouded Damage Mitigation Roll against all subsequent Shooting Attacks until it is returned to Aerial Reserves.

rules.name: Praesidium shield
rules.description: A model with a Praesidium shield gains a 5+ Invulnerable Save and the Shield Trait.

rules.name: Magisterium Vexilla
rules.description:
Units within 8" of a Model with a magisterium vexilla must pass a Leadership Check when scoring an Objective or only a single Victory Point is scored.


In the Victory Sub-Phase of any End Phase, when a Unit with at least one Model within Line of Sight and 8" of an enemy Model with a magisterium vexilla would score Victory Points for Controlling or Contesting an Objective, it must first make a Leadership Check. If this Check is failed, that Unit may only score 1 Victory Point for Controlling or Contesting the Objective in that Victory Sub-Phase, regardless of other Special Rules like Line (X) or Comptroller (X). If the Check is successful there is no further effect.

rules.name: Hetaeron Guard
rules.description: All Models in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Slot with this Prime Advantage which have the Legio Custodes Trait and the Infantry or Cavalry Type modify the value of X of any version of the Eternal Warrior (X) Special Rule they have to '2'. This Prime Advantage may only be selected once per Army, unless the Army contains any Models with the Golden Exemplar Trait, in which case a single additional selection of this Prime Advantage may be made for each Model in the Army with that Trait.

rules.name: Only in Death
rules.description:
"Units which only contain Models with this Special Rule become Stunned instead of Routed in Combat and cannot Fall Back or Disengage from a Combat."


Whenever a Model with this Special Rule would gain the Routed Tactical Status in the Make Panic Checks Step of the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, that Model instead gains the Stunned Tactical Status, unless there are any Models without this Special Rule in the same Unit as that Model. Additionally, a Unit which only contains Models with this Special Rule may never have the Disengage or Fall Back aftermath options selected for it, unless it is entirely composed of Models which also have the Antigrav Sub-Type, in which case it may still have the Disengage aftermath option selected for it.
